_about: The cases of a server planning for a page (docs/ONE_PLATFORM_PROGRAM_2026_10_12.md G1). The tab's planner on a
server (datacube/src/planner.ts, engine-client/src/pure-v1.ts) sends every request below as its `text`, byte for byte
(pure-protocol's toJson: `_type` first, then the keys in order; a decimal keeps its digits), refuses every `refused`
query before sending anything, reads every plan for its `database` (the type of its SQL's connection: the tab runs
DuckDB) as its `sql`, `columns` and `sqlTypes` (the columns' relationalType), and refuses every `refusals` answer in
its `message`. (Python's twin went 2026-10-15: a host plans in process.) legend-lite's plan was answered by its native
4.145.0's, written for H2. INTERIM: these become the cases of reading a server's plan in core
(docs/EXECUTION_PLAN_BOUNDARY_2026_10_05.md §8, phase 2), when the tab's hand-written reader goes.
